# Instagram Scraper

The Apify actor [`apidojo/instagram-scraper`](https://apify.com/apidojo/instagram-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.1158** (module version **0.3.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

Instagram scraper for posts and reels from profiles, hashtags, locations, audio, tagged and search URLs or keywords at $0.50 per 1,000 posts. Extract captions, likes, comments, plays, owner and location data. No login needed.

## Pricing

Pay per event — post $0.0005 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apidojo/instagram-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apidojo-instagram-scraper@0.3.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Telo.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `startUrls` | array |  |  | Instagram URLs — Instagram URLs. Paste the URLs, and get the results immediately. User, Tag, Location, Audio, Reels, Users' Tagged, Search, single post (/p/) and single reel (/reel/) URLs are supported. Provide this or Search keywords. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Results limit per URL — Maximum number of items each Instagram URL or keyword returns. Maximum items in total still caps the whole run. Duplicates and posts removed by Filter by date don't count. |
| `until` | string |  |  | Filter by date — Returns posts newer than this date. Enter a date or a relative value such as 7 days or 2 months, counted back from the run start in UTC. |
| `keywords` | array |  |  | Search keywords — Keywords to search Instagram posts by. Each keyword runs a separate search and returns matching posts (e.g. "travel"). Provide this or Instagram URLs. |
| `getReels` | boolean |  |  | Include reels for hashtags — When enabled, hashtag (Tag) URLs return the hashtag's reels in addition to its posts. Reels are not sorted by date, so Filter by date is not applied to them. |

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
